description: A. O. Smith Corporation is a manufacturer of water heating and water treatment products operating through two reporting segments, North America and Rest of World, with the Rest of World segment primarily comprising China, India, and Europe. Both segments manufacture and market comprehensive lines of residential and commercial gas and electric water heaters, boilers, heat pumps, tanks and water treatment products. Its products include electric, natural gas and liquid propane tank-type water heaters, tankless, heat pump and solar tank units, residential and commercial boilers, water softeners and filtration systems, expansion tanks, swimming pool and spa heaters, and commercial solar water heating systems. Sales in the North America segment accounted for approximately 78 percent of total sales in 2025.
